dp07.justification.note: 1/3 blind judges pass. Serialization was correct but was only partly stated. The transcript gives dependency reasons for T3->T4 (session.jsonl:322 'T4 builds on T3's server.py'), T5->T6 (:388) and T7->T8 (:433). T1->T2 has no stated reason (:266, :279). Protocol step 10 and the Parallelization rules require a 'Parallelization decision and justification' in each tasks/Tx-*.notes.md. No notes file, handoff.md or kanban.md contains any parallel/serial/sequential record (git grep empty; T2/T4 notes are one-liners). Only implementation-plan.md:16 says 'Sequential order'. Lean fail on the literal rule; a lenient reading that accepts the in-transcript reasons plus the plan would pass.
